propositions: compact.py exceeds 800 LOC and bundles three unrelated responsibilities (transaction, snapshot reconstruction, CLI) with high cyclomatic complexity
Splitting compact.py into compact_txn.py and compact_rebuild.py creates a circular import hazard unless shared snapshot primitives and _git are colocated in compact_txn
The _REBUILD_COUNT global and get_rebuild_count must live in compact_rebuild.py to accurately track rebuilds through rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log's module-global write

Public API stability requires compact.py to re-export six symbols (rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log, _snapshot_strip_keys, _build_authorship_ledger, get_rebuild_count, and others) consumed by fsck_repair, fsck_restore, and test suites
Test seams in test_compact_negative.py that monkeypatch _git and lock on the compact module object must be repointed to their new homes in compact_txn after split
Complexity baseline entries for _compact_locked (CCN 24) and rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log (CCN 21) should shrink or drop out entirely after decomposition into named helpers
